target_customer: Enterprise security teams wanting to stop malware from sending data out of their networks
problem: Malware that gets past perimeter defenses exfiltrates data over normal looking outbound web traffic, and companies lacked a way to block it.
business_model: Enterprise security proxy or appliance, pricing not documented

founders.name: Nir Krakowski
founders.background_notes: Insider profiles list him later as a co-founder of Deepdub (2019); not verified beyond aggregators.

founders.name: Itamar Gilad
founders.background_notes: Former technical leader at Microsoft per the YC page; now research and threat detection lead at Wiz.

competitors.name: Darktrace
competitors.what: Behavioral anomaly detection that has caught data exfiltration inside networks
competitors.traction_then: Press release in March 2016 describes catching a large exfiltration at an Italian bank
competitors.funding_then: More than $25M raised by 2016 per an industry list

technical_complexity.rationale: Telling malware traffic from human traffic at the network edge and installing like a firewall is difficult for two founders, with false positives a major risk.

defensibility.rationale: The approach was a detection method rather than data or integration lock-in, and large security vendors could add similar egress analysis.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying or buying Metapacket; it went inactive, listed as non active in December 2018.

market_need_then: TechCrunch at launch covered the method of flagging non-human outbound connections to block malware, in a period of rising breaches, but concrete demand evidence for this product was not found.

branding.domain_note: metapacket.com is now a parked domain for sale on GoDaddy (checked 2026).

brand_strength.rationale: Only one launch article and directory listings were found, and the name is easily confused with the similar Metapack.

outcome_analysis: Metapacket was a two person Summer 2016 YC security startup that tried to block malware by spotting non-human outbound traffic. Startup Nation Central lists it as non active from December 2018, and the site is now a parked domain. No shutdown announcement or post-mortem was found, so the cause of failure is not public. Directory data suggests only tiny seed funding, but that is unverified.
notes: CB Insights alone lists about $240K total across two seed rounds (March and August 2016) with Y Combinator and Barclays Accelerator; single aggregator so not recorded as rounds and coverage is none_found. It also describes the company as Tel Aviv based while YC says San Francisco. Exit date is from the Startup Nation Central inactive label and not a shutdown announcement. The only dated competitor found is Darktrace; Cisco Umbrella and others were not supported by sources.
